pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(7);
 RET NUMBER;
 DCLTN_REPS_PRINT NUMBER;

BEGIN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--AADED BY FAISAL RAIS ALOFI IN 5-7-1427 OR :CHECK2 =0
IF (:START_DT IS NOT NULL OR :END_DT IS NOT NULL )OR :CHECK2 =0 THEN 
SELECT
COUNT(DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD)INTO V_COUNT
FROM

DCLTN_STATUS L_DCLTN_ST,
IMPORTERS IMP,
BRKR_MSTR BKM,
DCLTN_TYPES L_DCLTNT,
IMPORTERS L_IMP,
DECLARATIONS DCLTN

WHERE
DCLTN.PORT_CD=:PORT
AND ((DCLTN.FINAL_CTRY_CD =100 AND :CNTYR_SELECT=0)OR
 (DCLTN.FINAL_CTRY_CD<>100 AND :CNTYR_SELECT=1)OR
 (:CNTYR_SELECT=2))
AND (DCLTN.LIC_TYPE=:P_LIC_TYPE OR :P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL)
AND (DCLTN.LIC_NBR=:P_LIC_NBR OR :P_LIC_NBR IS NULL)
AND (TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')>=TO_CHAR(NVL(:START_DT,:END_DT),'RRRR-MM-MI') OR :START_DT IS NULL)
AND (TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')<=TO_CHAR(NVL(:END_DT,:START_DT),'RRRR-MM-MI') OR :END_DT IS NULL)
AND ((DCLTN.DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :CHECK2 = 1 )OR :CHECK2=0)
AND (
 (
 DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND (DCLTN.IMPR_NBR=:P_IMPR_NBR OR :P_IMPR_NBR IS NULL) 
 
 )
 OR
 ( DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND (DCLTN.AGENT_NBR=:P_IMPR_NBR OR :P_IMPR_NBR IS NULL) 
 )
 )
/*AND (
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND 
 ( (DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN(9,11,12) AND :CHECK1=0 )OR :CHECK1=1)
 )
 OR
 (DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4, 5,6) AND
 ( (DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN(5) AND :CHECK1=0) OR :CHECK1=1 )
 )
 )
*/
---------------------------
AND (
 (
 ((DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0) OR :P_DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL)
 AND((DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (9,11,12,14)AND :SELECT1=2 )OR(:SELECT1<>2) )
 )
 OR 
 (
 ((DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=1 )OR :P_DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL) 
 AND((DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD NOT IN (5,9)AND :SELECT1=2 )OR(:SELECT1<>2) )
 )
 )

--AND ((DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=:P_DCLTN_STA AND :SELECT1=3) OR :SELECT1<>3 ) 

AND(DCLTN.INSPTR_ID = :P_INSPTR_ID OR :P_INSPTR_ID IS NULL)
AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = L_IMP.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN.AGENT_NBR = L_IMP.IMPR_NBR AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = L_DCLTNT.TYPE_ID AND
DCLTN.BRKR_PORT_CD = BKM.PORT_CD (+) AND
DCLTN.LIC_TYPE = BKM.LIC_TYPE (+) AND
DCLTN.LIC_NBR = BKM.LIC_NBR (+) AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = IMP.PORT_CD (+) AND
DCLTN.IMPR_NBR = IMP.IMPR_NBR (+) AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_TYPE_CD AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD = L_DCLTN_ST.DCLTN_STA_CD
AND

( ---------1
( ----+
:SELECT1 = 3 AND NVL(:PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR,0) = 1 AND
( ---------5
 
 ( ------2
 ( :P_DCLTN_TYPE = 0 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD <> 6 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(1,2) and DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=:P_DCLTN_STA)
 OR
 (:P_DCLTN_TYPE = 1 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD <> 8 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(3,4,5,6) and DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=:P_DCLTN_STA)
 ) ------2
 
 OR 
 
 ( ------0
 ( -------3
 ( DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD = 6 AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE=0 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(1,2) ) 
 OR
 ( DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD = 8 AND :P_DCLTN_TYPE= 1 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN(3,4,5,6) )
 ) -------3
 AND DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN IN 
 ( SELECT DECSUS.DCLTN_ISN 
 FROM DCLTN_SUSPNS DECSUS
 WHERE DCLTN.PORT_CD = DECSUS.PORT_CD AND 
 DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN = DECSUS.DCLTN_ISN AND
 DECSUS.DCLTN_STA_CD = :P_DCLTN_STA AND DECSUS.SUSPN_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(DS2.SUSPN_SEQ)
 FROM DCLTN_SUSPNS DS2 WHERE DCLTN.PORT_CD = DS2.PORT_CD AND DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN = DS2.DCLTN_ISN) )
 
 )--------0
) ---------5

)----+
 OR
(:SELECT1 = 3 AND NVL(:PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR,0) = 0 AND ( DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD=:P_DCLTN_STA AND :SELECT1=3) )
 OR 
 (:SELECT1 <> 3 ) -----+

)----------1
;
 
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 if v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 
 DCLTN_REPS_PRINT :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DCLTN_REPS_PRINT',999),0);

 IF DCLTN_REPS_PRINT <> '1' OR :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD <> 4 OR 
 :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE <> 2 OR :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID <> 1 THEN
 IF :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE IS NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DISABLEPRINT',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 -------

 END IF;
 -------
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 --:FINANCE_DT := revenue.get_fiscal_year_start(:start_dt);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_STA',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_STA);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DCLTN_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_IMPR_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_IMPR_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_LIC_NBR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(NVL(:START_DT,:END_DT),'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(NVL(:END_DT,:START_DT),'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DEC_INS_REP_USR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR);
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_INSPTR_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_INSPTR_ID); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CHECK2',TEXT_PARAMETER,:CHECK2);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'SELECT1',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SELECT1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CNTYR_SELECT',TEXT_PARAMETER,:CNTYR_SELECT);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 
 else
 
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1, 100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if; 

 ELSE

 END IF;
